blocks.text: The group’s manufacturing foothold in pharma

Purview Life Sciences anchors the Life Sciences half of the group’s Healthcare and Life Sciences vertical, in Hyderabad’s pharmaceutical corridor. It gives Purview a manufacturing business alongside its healthcare operations and a route into GMP intermediates and APIs.
